summary: BioStem Technologies filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, disclosing a committed equity facility (common stock purchase agreement) with Roth Principal Investments, LLC. The company may, at its sole discretion, sell up to $40,000,000 of common stock over up to 36 months from commencement, via market-open, intraday, pre-market or post-market purchases. A related registration rights agreement covers resale of up to 12,050,000 purchase shares. No price, premium or board recommendation stated. Deal terms are at-the-market and discretionary, so the risk-arb angle centers on potential dilution and share-price overhang.
